movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands held with neighbors to form a continuous circle
movement_profile.footwork: Walking steps around the circle, interspersed with running and jumping
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circle around seated elders; dancers move clockwise or counterclockwise
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Natural movement following steps; not described as isolated or stylized
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes walking, running, and jumping; complexity varies by tribe
movement_profile.partnering: Girls approach boys they favor; partner selection through dance proximity and betel nut exchange
movement_profile.posture: Upright, relaxed, holding hands in a circle

signature_moves.description: Walking hand in hand around the elders in a continuous circle
signature_moves.name: Circle Walk

signature_moves.description: Intermittent running movements within the circle dance
signature_moves.name: Running Step

signature_moves.description: Jumping motions added to the walking and running steps
signature_moves.name: Jumping Step

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Steady, rhythmic pace matching the music and group movement
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid disrupting the elders or sacred rituals; respect the ceremonial context

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Call-and-response singing led by a soloist with chorus
music_profile.sound_description: The music features a lead vocal line with a responsive chorus, creating a layered communal sound that supports the rhythmic walking, running, and jumping of the dancers.
music_profile.vocal_style: Lead singer initiates song, chorus follows; lyrics vary by age and tribe

basic_steps: Form a circle holding hands around seated elders
Walk forward in rhythm around the circle
Girls approach boys they favor and dance alongside
Exchange betel nuts as partner selection gesture
teaching.formation: Hand-in-hand circle around elders seated centrally
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start by learning to walk and hold hands in the circle; intermediate dancers add running and jumping; advanced dancers perform complex coastal variations.
teaching.rhythm: Songs led by a soloist with chorus response; steady rhythmic pattern matching walking and running steps
